summary: Iteration 94 - Testing 2 UX fixes: (1) BOM Create/Edit dialog breathing room + SearchableItemSelect X clear button, (2) GRN partial qty clarity with renamed columns and colored headers. ALL FIXES VERIFIED WORKING.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data (PO000019 with partial status)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two UX fixes verified: (1) BOM dialog has 280px spacer at bottom for dropdown breathing room, SearchableItemSelect has X clear button when query has no matches, panel position fixed with 80px floor for empty state. (2) GRN dialog columns renamed for clarity with colored headers (brown for Pending, green for Recd Now) and tooltips.

frontend.description: Typed 'XYZQQQ123NOMATCH' in parent item search. X clear button appeared inside input (data-testid='bom-parent-item-select-clear-input'). Clicking X cleared the input text and re-focused the input.

frontend.test: BOM SearchableItemSelect Empty State Panel Position
frontend.description: 'No items found' panel displayed below input without overlapping. Panel positioned at y=197, input bottom at y=193. Uses 80px floor for empty state height calculation.
280px spacer div found in BOM dialog (class h-[280px], aria-hidden=true). Provides vertical breathing room for search dropdown of last component row.
X clear button found on component row search input (data-testid='component-item-select-2-clear-input'). Panel positioned correctly below input.
Column headers now read: Item, HSN, PO Qty, Already Recd, Pending (this GRN), Recd Now, UOM, PO Price, Cost/Unit, Total Cost, Status. 'Ordered' renamed to 'PO Qty'.
'Pending (this GRN)' has brown background (rgb(114, 59, 19)). 'Recd Now' has green background (rgb(3, 84, 63)).

Tooltips found: 'Original PO ordered qty' (PO Qty), 'Cumulative qty already received via earlier GRNs' (Already Recd), 'Remaining qty pending for this GRN' (Pending), 'Editable: how much you actually received in this delivery — pre-filled with pending' (Recd Now).
PO000019 (partial status): PO Qty=10, Already Recd=3, Pending=7, Recd Now=7 (pre-filled with pending qty). Logic correctly shows remaining qty for this GRN.
